LanguageData.GV_MustPlaceUnderRoof: Must be placed under a roof.
LanguageData.GV_VentOutputOutOfBounds: The vent would blow gas off the map.
LanguageData.GV_VentOutputBlocked: The vent's output cell is blocked.
LanguageData.GV_PipeBlocksVentOutput: A vent is blowing gas into this cell; connect the pipe from another side.
LanguageData.GV_VentModeDesc: Cycle the vent between off, always on, and sensor-controlled. Sensor-controlled vents open while an armed intruder sensor in the same room detects targets.
LanguageData.GV_VentGasesDesc: Choose which gas(es) this vent outputs. Any combination; each draws from its own network independently.
LanguageData.GV_ManifoldGasDesc: Choose which gas this manifold accepts and feeds into its network. A pawn must carry out a short reconfigure task to change it; any stored gas is vented and racked canisters ejected when it does.
LanguageData.GV_CeilingVentFell: {0} fell from the ceiling after the roof above it was removed.
LanguageData.GV_DeconstructGasPipesDesc: Designate gas pipes of any gas for deconstruction, including hidden pipes under walls, floors and vents.
LanguageData.GV_HaywireBerserkReason: Haywire gas scrambled its control systems.
LanguageData.GV_RemovedAllContent: Gas Ventilation: removed {0} things and {1} hediffs. Save, then disable the mod.
LanguageData.GV_SensorArmedDesc: While armed and powered, the sensor opens sensor-controlled vents in its room when targets are present.
LanguageData.GV_SensorTargetsDesc: Choose which kinds of intruders trigger the sensor.
LanguageData.GV_SensorLingerDesc: How long vents stay open after the last target leaves the room.
LanguageData.GV_SensorStopWhenDownedDesc: Close the vents as soon as every target in the room is downed (useful with sedative gas for taking prisoners).
LanguageData.GV_SensorPasteDesc: Apply the copied sensor settings to this sensor.
LanguageData.GV_SensorInspectOpenRoom: This room is open to the map edge; the sensor will not trigger.
